messages:
alex: Heads up — Helia Labs (enterprise AI analytics) is pushing for an early-adopter rebate. They want 25% off list on a 12mo POC with Dedicated capacity for year 1. Asking to close this week. Can ops/finance weigh in?

maria: Quick context — prospect already committed to a 6mo eval, wants 12mo if we give material price concession. ARR-ish if converted ~ $300k/yr. They asked specifically for 25% up front + a 6mo usage credit.

jordan: tagging in revops. 25% is pretty steep for Dedicated. Standard early-adopter rebate we allow is 10–15% + marketing/case study credit. Any commercial levers (prepay, shorter SLA term) we can use?

frank: Finance here — we can stretch to 18% if they provide a signed case study + 60% prepay. Need CFO ok for anything >15% that impacts run rate. Also need to confirm if Dedicated infra surcharge applies (adds ~8% to cost).

alex: They asked for zero upfront infra surcharge to simplify the ask. They want predictable cost. Also pushing on data residency (VPC). Could do 12mo commit + VPC (private) — that increases onboarding effort.

maria: Proposed commercial compromise I'll pitch: 15% list discount + $25k usage credit applied over first 3 months + case study commitment. Or 20% if they prepay 60% and sign MSA addendum for data residency. Thoughts?

jordan: That aligns with deal desk guardrails. Need a formal ask doc — include list price, net ARR calculation, effective discount, and finance impact. I'll run the numbers:
```
List ARR: $300,000
15% discount -> $255,000
$25k credit spread -> effective first-year $230,000 (net of credits)
```

frank: That calculation looks right. With Dedicated infra surcharge (8%) our cost baseline shifts. If we waive surcharge, margin hit is bigger. 20% + 60% prepay gets us back to acceptable margin.

alex: Customer prefers no prepay. They're a startup but high strategic value (AI benchmarks + partnerships). Want to avoid scaring them off.

maria: I'll draft the formal deal request for deal desk: include recommended approval path: 15% + $25k credit + case study, legal to approve VPC addendum with SOC2 attestation, finance to approve up to 18% if marketing/case study not secured.

frank: If deal desk needs to approve >15%, need CFO + Head of Partnerships notified. I'll pre-clear 18% contingent on case study and 60% of infra surcharge passed through.

deals-bot: @channel Deal desk request created: DD-2026-0417. Please attach the doc in the thread within 24h for auto-routing. (link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-0417)

maria: Uploaded the ask doc and pricing workbook to the deal: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-0417#attachments. Includes legal notes, MSA redline, and customer LOI.

jordan: Running approval calc now — will update with recommended approvers and expected margin impact by EOD.

alex: Thanks — priority is to keep momentum. If we can get a 15% + credit + case study, I'll move to get LOI signed this week. :v:
